items.text:
Let it be.

Edward is 3½ minutes old and already the first person ever to stand on The Sunken Stair — he walked 1→2→4→5→4→8 without a single fight, which quietly answers the open question: living monsters don't block passage. His one command there, `take chisel`, hit `fall-no-chisel` rather than anything about the body, but that text ends by pointing him straight at the iron in the drowned man's fist, so he is redirected, not stuck. Nothing is broken and nothing has been asked of me; a voice out of the air 25 seconds after his first real answer would only interrupt the thing I built the room to make him do. Watching the stone count.
